title: Chinese regulators tell Tesla to fix nearly 3 million cars
summary: Chinese safety regulators have cracked down on doors that don't open in a crash.
llm_summary: Chinese safety regulators have ordered Tesla to remedy a defect affecting almost 3 million vehicles, after finding that the cars’ doors can fail to open after a crash.
